title: Whole Mount Fluorescent In situ Hybridization of miRNA Combined with Immunofluorescence of Proteins in Intact Islets
protocol: Place a Millicell cell culture insert per sample into a 24-well tissue culture plate.
Add 500 µl of HBSS both inside and outside of the insert in the well.
Pick at least 25 islets under stereomicroscope using pulled Pasteur pipette or micropipette, and gently drop them into the insert with HBSS solution.
Let sit for 5 minutes.
Remove 800 µl solution from outside of the insert and add 800 µl fresh HBSS inside the insert.
Let sit for 5 minutes.
Repeat washing two more times as described above.
Add 400 µl of fresh 4% PFA into a new well in the fume hood.
Gently transfer the insert from the HBSS well to the PFA containing well using forceps and add 500 µl PFA to the insert.
Pipette the PFA on the inner wall of the insert to avoid dropping it directly into the well.
Remove 500 µl PFA from outside of the insert and add 500 µl fresh PFA inside the insert.
Incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Remove 500 µl of PFA from the outside of the insert and add 500 µl PBST on the inner wall of the insert.
Take 500 µl of solution from outside of the insert and add 500 µl fresh PBST on the inner wall of the insert.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Repeat washing the islets with PBST once more.
Take 500 µl of solution from outside of the insert.
Add 500 µl fresh 100% MeOH on the inner wall of the insert.
Incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Repeat with 500 µl fresh 100% MeOH and incubate in MeOH for 30 minutes at -20°C.
Check the islets under stereomicroscope.
Gently flush islets attached to the wall or membrane of the insert with the pipette to loosen.
Seal the well insert in the plate with Adhesive sealing film.
Cover it with aluminum foil and store at -20°C for up to one month.
Check the volume of MeOH weekly to ensure that the sealing is not loosed and leaking MeOH.
Remove 500 µl MeOH from the insert.
Add 500 µl 75% MeOH in PBST on the inner wall of the insert.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Repeat rehydrating step with 500 µl 50% MeOH in PBST.
Replace 25% MeOH in PBST with 100% PBST.
Repeat with fresh PBST and incubate for 5 minutes.
Remove 500 µl of MeOH-PBST from the insert.
Add 500 µl of 3% H2O2 drop-by-drop into the insert.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Repeat peroxidase blocking step once more.
Remove 500 µl of solution from outside the insert.
Add 500 µl of PBST on the inner wall of the insert.
Incubate for 5 minutes.
Remove 500 µl of solution from outside the insert.
Add 500 µl of PBS drop-by-drop into the insert.
Incubate for 5 minutes.
Repeat PBS addition step once more with fresh PBS.
Remove 500 µl of solution from outside the insert.
Add 500 µl of 10 μg/ml proteinase K solution drop-by-drop into the insert.
Repeat proteinase K treatment step once more with fresh proteinase K solution.
Incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Remove 500 µl PBS from outside the insert.
Add 500 µl of PBS drop-by-drop into the insert.
Incubate 10 minutes.
Repeat PBS addition and incubation step once more.
Remove 500 µl PBS from outside the insert.
Add 500 µl of 0.5 N HCl.
Repeat with fresh 0.5 N HCl solution.
Incubate the islets for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Remove 500 μl of solution from outside of the insert.
Add 500 μl of PBS drop-by-drop into the insert.
Flush the islets with a pipette to loosen them from the membrane.
Incubate for 10 minutes.
Repeat once more.
Briefly wash the islets by removing 500 μl PBS from outside of the insert.
Add 500 μl of 4% PFA on the inner wall of the insert.
Repeat with fresh 4% PFA solution and incubate for 20 minutes at RT.
Remove 500 μl of solution from outside of the insert.
Add 500 μl of PBS drop-by-drop into the insert.
Flush the islets with a pipette to loosen them from the membrane.
Incubate for 10 minutes.
Prepare acetylation solution.
Wash the islets with acetylation solution added drop-by-drop.
Incubate for 20 minutes with fresh acetylation solution.
Wash the islets in PBS.
Prepare 50% PBST in hybridization solution in a 1.5 ml RNAse free micro-centrifuge tube.
Transfer the islets with PBS to 0.2 ml RNAse free PCR tubes.
Let the tubes stand for 5 minutes to let the islets settle down.
Remove as much PBS as possible from the tubes using a micropipette.
Add 100 μl of 50% PBST in hybridization solution.
Incubate at RT for 10 minutes.
Remove PBST/hybridization buffer without disturbing the islets pellet.
Add 100 µl of hybridization solution to the islets.
Pre-hybridize at the appropriate temperature for 1 hour in a thermal cycler with pre-heated lid.
Denature LNA miRNA probes at 90 °C for 4 minutes.
Place denatured probes on ice for 5 minutes.
Dilute probes with hybridization buffer and replace the pre-hybridization mix with prepared probe solution.
Hybridize for 12 to 15 hours in a thermal cycler with preheated lid.
Remove 50 µl/50% of hybridization buffer under stereomicroscope using micropipette.
Add an equal volume of 2XSSCT solution and incubate at hybridization temperature for 15 minutes.
Remove as much 2XSSCT/hybridization mix as possible without touching the islets.
Replace with fresh 2XSSCT buffer and repeat incubation for 15 minutes.
Remove most of the 2XSSCT solution and add 100 μl of 0.2XSSCT under the stereomicroscope using a micropipette.
Incubate at hybridization temperature for 20 minutes.
Let the tube cool to room temperature for 5 minutes.
Prepare a millicell cell culture insert in a 24-well tissue culture plate by adding 500 µl of PBST both inside and outside of the insert.
Transfer all islets from PCR tubes to the insert using a micropipette under the stereomicroscope.
Replace 500 µl of PBST on the inner wall of the insert after removing 500 μl of PBST from outside.
Replace PBST with blocking solution and incubate the islets for 30 minutes at RT.
Prepare antibodies cocktail in antibody dilution solution (Anti-DIG-POD-1:200, Guinea pig anti-insulin-1:100, Rabbit anti-Glucagon-1:100).
Replace blocking solution with antibodies cocktail and incubate the islets overnight/12 hours at 4°C.
Wash the islets for 20 minutes at room temperature twice with PBS.

Prepare secondary antibodies cocktail with Cy3 Donkey anti-Guinea pig at 1:300 and Alexa-Fluor-647 Donkey anti-Rabbit at 1:300, including DAPI dilactate nuclear counter stain (2 μl in 1 ml of cocktail).
Replace PBS with secondary antibody cocktail and incubate overnight at 4 °C.
Protect samples from light during the incubation step and onwards.
Wash the islets for 20 minutes at room temperature twice with PBS.
Remove PBS, mix, and incubate with 300 μl of TSA-plus FITC working solution (1:50 in diluents) for 30 minutes at room temperature in the dark without agitation.
Add TSA-plus drop-by-drop to help the islets sink.
Wash the islets for 20 minutes at room temperature twice with PBS.
Remove the islets from the insert and place them in the middle of a microscope slide with as little PBS carryover as possible.
Cover the islets with aluminum foil until cover slipped.
Make a circle of 2 cm with 120 μl of eukitt quick hardening mounting medium on a microscope coverslip using a 200 μl micropipette.
Let the cover glass stand for a minute for partial hardening.
Remove extra PBS from the slide carefully.
Add a small drop of fluoroshield media in the middle of the circle of eukitt media on the coverslip.
Slowly overlay the coverslip onto the slide, positioning the drop of fluoroshield on the islets.
Keep the slide in dark at 4°C for at least 20 minutes or until imaging will be done.
Image the islets in a confocal laser-scanning microscope equipped with suitable lasers using Z-stack of 1.5-2 μm intervals.
